Sam: Hey, lost my wallet and can't find my insurance card. I have a same-day specialist appointment in ~2 hours. Will a screenshot of the insurer app be enough or can People Ops issue a temporary proof letter?

Maya (Benefits): A screenshot with name + policy number usually works, but some clinics require a formal proof. We can generate a one-page coverage letter and email it to the clinic. If you want that, reply with provider name, clinic email/fax, appointment time, and your DOB or employee ID.

Sam: Provider is Northside ENT, appt 15:30, clinic fax 555-0187, DOB 1987-11-02. Please email them if possible.

Maya (Benefits): Got it. Creating temporary coverage letter now and will email clinic and DM you the PDF. If clinic needs an auth number we'll call insurer and update you here.

Lena (People Ops Bot): Ticket PO-9642 opened, priority: high (same-day). Assigned to Maya. ETA ~45 minutes.
